page.overview:
Who is Evonyn?

Evonyn was a Dúnedain character created for the fanfilm Born of Hope.

Evonyn was the mother of Halbarad. She was also the wife of Halbaron, who was also created in Born of Hope. When a girl named Maia's village was attacked, her people fled north to the Dúnedain settlement of Taurdal. Evonyn adopted Maia.
